# Asaan Lang

> Pakistan ki apni Urdu / Roman-Urdu educational programming language.
> Think in Urdu, code in Urdu, compile websites from the same language.

- Developer: Muaaz Iqbal (Kasur / Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan)
- Profile / store: https://mizanora.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/muaaziqbalvip
- Docs: https://asaan-lang.vercel.app/docs
- Ecosystem: https://asaan-lang.vercel.app/ecosystem
- License: MIT

Install: clone https://github.com/muaaziqbalvip/asaan-lang then ./install.sh
Run: asaan file.asaan   |   asaan --studio   |   asaan --web site.asaan -o site.html
